prompt: Create a premium modern e-commerce storefront for a lifestyle and fashion brand. Include a responsive navigation bar, hero section, product categories, product grid, product cards, product filtering, shopping cart, quantity controls, subtotal and total calculations, and a professional footer. Make the interactions functional.

designSpec.purpose: Provide a high-end, immersive e-commerce storefront for a modern lifestyle and fashion brand with seamless cart management and filtering.
designSpec.targetAudience: Trendsetting fashion consumers, minimalist lifestyle enthusiasts, and boutique luxury shoppers seeking curation and effortless digital checkout.
designSpec.visualDirection: High-end minimalist aesthetic featuring generous whitespace, crisp typography, subtle monochromatic borders, and vibrant photography.

heading.usage: Hero titles, primary product headings, and brand mastheads.

body.usage: Product descriptions, navigation items, pricing, and filters.

mono.usage: SKU numbers, coupon codes, and cart item codes.

layout.structure: Asymmetrical editorial grid with sticky sidebar filtering and fixed-width sliding shopping cart drawer.

componentStyling.cardStyle: Clean architectural cards with subtle hover zoom on images and quick-add actions.

navigation.details: Minimalist top bar featuring brand logo, category navigation links, search trigger, wishlist count, and interactive sliding cart drawer trigger with live badge count.

hero.headline: ELEVATED ESSENTIALS FOR MODERN LIVING.
hero.subheadline: Discover our new season collection combining sustainable craftsmanship with uncompromising contemporary silhouettes.
hero.details: High-impact split layout with immersive editorial photography on one side and bold Syne display typography on the other.

mediaDirection.description: Monochromatic and warm-toned studio photography focusing on garment texture, minimalist draping, and lifestyle accessories.
mediaDirection.imageTreatment: High contrast, clean neutral backgrounds with subtle warm color grading.
mediaDirection.iconStyle: Clean, thin-stroke SVG icons matching 1.5px weight.

motion.strategy: Subtle, butter-smooth micro-interactions including sliding cart drawer transitions, image zoom on product card hover, and instant filter state updates.

responsive.mobileStrategy: Collapsible filter drawer replacing sidebar, touch-optimized product grids, and full-screen mobile navigation menu.

accessibility.contrastRatio: WCAG AAA compliant (dark charcoal text on warm paper background)

designSpec.signature: Interactive sliding cart pill with instant badge updates, real-time subtotal calculations, and seamless quantity controls.

filesPlanned.description: Main application component managing global cart state, filters, modal drawers, and assembling the storefront layout.
Global stylesheets with Google Fonts import for Syne and Plus Jakarta Sans, design tokens, and smooth transitions.
Sticky navigation header with brand logotype, navigation links, search trigger, and interactive cart badge button.
Split hero composition featuring high-end lifestyle imagery, bold typography, and immediate call-to-action.
Asymmetrical editorial product grid paired with a sticky sidebar filter for seamless category and price navigation.
Sliding shopping cart drawer with real-time subtotal calculations, quantity modifiers, and checkout simulation.
Professional footer with newsletter subscription, brand links, copyright notice, and payment badges.

items.description: Grid or list rendering catalog products dynamically

items.description: Click handler to add products to the active cart

items.name: Cart Quantity Controls & Item Removal
items.description: Controls to increment, decrement, or remove items from the cart

items.name: Cart Price Calculation
items.description: Mathematical computation of subtotal, tax, or total amount

items.name: Responsive Mobile/Desktop Layout
items.description: Mobile-first grid and flex responsive breakpoints
